summary: Slice 5 (Admin Payout Console) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering auth guard, list shape (driver + bank nested, last-4 masking, newest-first), status/country/q filters, buckets independent of q, mark-paid + mark-failed transitions, 409 guards on non-pending rows, empty note stored as null, and driver-side balance recomputation (available_balance restored on failed, stays reduced on paid). Frontend E2E on /admin/driver-payouts covers sidebar entry, all 4 tabs with badge counts, KPI (₹312 across 2 requests), mark-paid happy path with chip flip to Paid, mark-failed dialog with note ('ifsc invalid') visible under chip, and search filter. All test-ids present as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: mark-paid endpoint sets w.failure_note = None explicitly (good), so re-paying would clear a stale note — but 409 guard prevents this path anyway.
buckets query scans full DriverWithdrawal table on every list call (fine now, but add index on status if the table grows).
admin_list_withdrawals uses ILIKE on Driver.name and phone_e164 — Postgres does not use index for leading-wildcard ILIKE; acceptable for ops console volume.
